FRB Sightline Galaxy Intersection Dashboard

Per-target intervening galaxies & virial halo calculations — 9 northern-cap sightlines

CHIME × DSA Joint Scattering Fits

Slide deck. Click the frame, then use the arrow keys (or the on-screen Prev / Next buttons) to navigate. Measures the scattering index α (τ∝ν−α) from the joint CHIME+DSA cross-band τ lever.

Freya — Scattering Validated, Scintillation Unresolved

Visual proof. (1) residuals go white → the α=4.48 scattering fit is real; (2) the gain-marginal scintillation framework recovers a known Δνd when resolved, so freya's collapsed ACF is genuine, not a detector blind spot; (3) freya's scintillation is unresolved in both bands, the coarse 5.5 MHz estimate was broadband contamination, and the τ↔Δνd ~1000× gap implies host vs Galactic screens.
